items.title: Network Bio partners with Duke University on AI disease models
items.summary: Network Bio has entered into a research collaboration with Duke University to develop AI models of human disease using biospecimens and clinical records.

items.title: Bio-Thera gains Chinese approval for spondylitis and rheumatoid arthritis drug
items.summary: China's NMPA has granted marketing authorisation for Bio-Thera Solutions’ BAT2506 to treat ankylosing spondylitis and rheumatoid arthritis.

items.title: Lonza is doubling down on US and ADC expansion with its Merck CDMO deal
items.summary: Lonza’s deal to acquire almost all of Merck KGaA’s US CDMO network will significantly boost its US footprint and capabilities in key areas.

items.title: FDA expands J&J’s Rybrevant Faspro label with head and neck cancer approval
items.summary: The accelerated approval marks the first indication beyond lung cancer for J&J’s bispecific antibody.

items.title: MHRA champions patient voices through new policy
items.summary: Through its PPIE initiative, the MHRA plans to consider a diverse range of patient and public opinions when making regulatory decisions.
